rules.title: Name authoritative requirements
rules.requirement: The accepted product proposal or specification is authoritative; accepted ADRs record later durable decisions. Derived task state and generated policy do not override either.

rules.title: Keep one bounded leaf active
rules.requirement: Represent implementation work in noise tasks and keep only one independently verifiable leaf task in progress.

rules.title: Deliver one coherent change
rules.requirement: Use a short-lived branch for one coherent idea and squash-merge its reviewed pull request.

rules.title: Run deterministic candidate checks
rules.requirement: Run the project-owned deterministic checks against the exact candidate revision before requesting formal review.

rules.title: Require independent exact-head review
rules.requirement: Agent-authored work requires formal review of the exact candidate revision by an approved high-capability model from a different model family than the implementer.

rules.title: Keep review visible and current
rules.requirement: Formal review must use an auditable project surface; a changed candidate invalidates prior approval and unresolved review threads block completion.
evidence: PROPOSAL.md: invisible-review incident and visible history

rules.title: Stop for external authority
rules.requirement: Credentials, spend, deployment, publication, remote creation, repository settings, package publication, and other external effects require explicit human authority.

rules.title: Use the evidence that can prove the claim
rules.requirement: When deterministic checks cannot prove runtime or visual behavior, obtain evidence from the specialist runtime or visual owner without treating lifecycle integrity as that evidence.

rules.title: Keep sensitive data out of artifacts
rules.requirement: Do not inspect, store, commit, log, or transmit credentials, authentication output, environment values, private transcripts, or hidden reasoning.

rules.title: Name enforcement owners honestly
rules.requirement: Every gate names its provider, project command, manual judgment, or advisory status; noise sdlc verifies only its managed artifact integrity.
